design_spec.scope_boundary: usable from elsewhere in the user's account/workspace while remaining external to this ChatGPT Project
design_spec.public_boundary: a thin stable facade/client of the existing application-building machinery, not a reproduction of that machinery
design_spec.runtime_boundary: one existing runtime remains authoritative; do not create a second public runtime, scheduler, program store, or build engine
design_spec.implementation_boundary: gateway hands account-facing requests into existing machinery and returns a stable result projection; transport/runtime internals remain behind the boundary

required_outputs: account-scoped gateway into existing build machinery
required_behaviors: delegate substantive execution to the existing machinery
keep the account-facing contract stable even if internal runtime/schema/registry implementation changes
allow callers outside this Project to use the builder without understanding internal execution transport
preserve result/artifact/receipt references needed by callers
constraints: requirements specify observable deliverable properties rather than prescribing fulfillment strategy unless method is itself a product requirement
do not infer a native primitive from a conceptual role or configuration value
remote/local collaboration used during construction is not part of the product unless explicitly required
implementation may compose Apps Script and Sheet-Cell capabilities
existing runtime and state machinery remain behind the facade
prohibited_outputs_or_exposures: three-worker barriers or worker topology as public product structure
completion_conditions: all specified interface artifacts exist and correspond to the stable account-facing boundary
gateway demonstrably delegates through existing machinery rather than duplicating it
external/account-scoped caller can submit supported requests and obtain supported state/results
internal engine representations are not exposed through the public contract
completion claims are independently read back from authoritative state
evidence_requirements: direct execution evidence for gateway delegation
direct request/result evidence through the account-facing boundary
receipts/provenance where the project contracts require them

prior_tradeoff_findings: The prior permutation analysis fed explorers essentially the goal alone; explorer_alpha drifted into a fault-tolerant distributed-transaction architecture while explorer_beta modeled the meta-search system.
The prior adversary itself identified that the two explorers evaluated different target domains.

The attempted Application Builder run converted worker_max_count=3 into three required remote-worker tasks and a barrier, causing a block and extensive orchestration debugging unrelated to the product boundary.
completion_and_evidence_requirements: do not declare a design/build phase complete from semantic plausibility alone
verify persistent artifacts and external/runtime effects through direct readback
preserve evidence tying public operations to actual delegation into existing machinery
